purpose: Teach: 終焉/連立/決戦/火力/耕/媒介/シリア/精進

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、競争の終焉は、まだまだ、遠い、攻めていけ、社員、士気、高く保て。
lines.en: The end of industry rivalry is still far off. We need to attack aggressively and keep our staff morale high.
lines.style: Clipped opening, measured cadence. Authority without volume. Each phrase lands—clean attacks on key words. Steady breath under the whole thing. The voice of someone who has said this before and means it differently each time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界団体との連立、当社も、リーダーシップを、発揮しております、最近、特に。
lines.en: Yes. We've been demonstrating real leadership in our coalitions with industry associations, especially recently.
lines.style: Professional, clear. Not defensive—just reporting fact. Moderate pace, even keel. The kind of update a trusted lieutenant gives: competent, unhurried, ears still listening for what the boss wants next.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 年末商戦、決戦の時期だ、社員一丸となって、頑張れ、私も、現場に出る。
lines.en: The year-end sales push is our decisive moment. Our whole staff needs to move as one. I'm going to be out in the field too.
lines.style: Shift to firmer resolve. Slight emphasis on the personal commitment—「私も出る」 carries weight. Slower on the closing words. The voice of someone signalling: this is not just strategy, this is where we prove what we're made of.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。火力発電依存の旧設備、再エネに、置き換え、進めております。
lines.en: Yes. We're making progress replacing our old thermal power equipment with renewable energy sources.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact update. No colour, no pause—just steady, methodical delivery. Like checking off a list he's already memorized. Professional but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業時、私自身も、田を耕すような気持ちで、ゼロから、事業を、育てた。
lines.en: When I founded this company, I tilled the soil myself—built it from nothing, the way a farmer builds a field.
lines.style: A pause before starting—breath, then a quieter register. Reflective, almost to himself, but meant for the room. Slower. The memory lives in his voice. Trailing slightly at the end, like he's seeing it again.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報伝達、社内SNSが、媒介となって、迅速化、しております、最近。
lines.en: Yes. Our internal SNS has really accelerated how we share information across the company. It's made a real difference lately.
lines.style: Steady professional tone. Slightly warm—he believes in what he's saying about the staff. Not rushing. The update of someone who notices small improvements and respects what they add up to.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: シリアでの人道支援事業、当社、参画、検討しろ、社会貢献として。
lines.en: Look into our participation in humanitarian operations in Syria. We should be studying how to contribute there as a company.
lines.style: Directive, but not harsh. Weight on the instruction—not a casual suggestion. Calm authority. He's opening a door, not ordering blind obedience. Slight pause before 「参画」 to let it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の日々の精進、本当に、当社の財産です、感謝、しなければなりません。
lines.en: Yes. The daily dedication of our staff—that's truly the real asset of this company. We need to show gratitude for that.
lines.style: Warm sincerity underneath. Not sentimental, but genuine. Slower pacing on the second half—「本当に」 carries feeling. Trailing off gently on the gratitude part, like an acknowledgement that words are never quite enough.
